notes.title: Two New Fighters Join the Battle on August 12 — For Free
notes.content: [h1]Hello Dragon Warriors!  [/h1][p]Double Dragon Gaiden: Rise of the Dragons is getting two new characters in a free DLC update coming August 12 — and they are anything but ordinary. [/p][h2]🖤 EVIL MARIAN [/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053314/94b4662ff17b0d6cfd7c4bbecee6404f30b8c1a2.png"][/img][/p][p]Once an ally, now possessed by an unknown force. notes.title: Two New Fighters Join the Fray!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Dragon Warriors[/h1]

The streets just got a lot more dangerous.

We’re thrilled to announce the launch of a FREE DLC for Double Dragon Gaiden: Rise of the Dragons, available NOW on Steam! This explosive update introduces two brand-new playable characters to the roster: Jeff, a ruthless street-hardened rival of the Lee brothers, and Abore, a mysterious juggernaut of brute force and unshakable calm.

[previewyoutube=1oVFPDebyTw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]🔥 Meet the New Fighters[/h2]
[h3]JEFF[/h3]
Once a childhood rival of Billy and Jimmy Lee, Jeff trained alongside the brothers in Sōsetsuken—but envy got the best of him. Unable to match their discipline and prowess, Jeff carved his own dark path, blending dirty street fighting with traditional technique. Fast, unpredictable, and aggressive, Jeff is perfect for players who love to dominate with relentless combos and a chip on their shoulder.

[h3]ABORE[/h3]
Massive. Mysterious. Merciless. Abore is a former soldier whose immense size and sheer power make him a force of nature. Whether he’s man or machine, no one knows—but his devastating grapples and tank-like resilience speak volumes. Ideal for players who prefer raw power and imposing presence, Abore offers a completely new way to bulldoze through enemies.

These two unique additions bring the total number of unlockable characters to 14, each with their own signature moves and playstyles. Whether you're a veteran looking for a reason to dive back in or a newcomer curious about the chaos, there’s never been a better time to jump into the fight.

[h2]💥 Limited-Time Deal: 60% Off![/h2]
To celebrate the release of this free DLC, Double Dragon Gaiden: Rise of the Dragons is 60% OFF for a limited time on Steam. There’s never been a better chance to squad up and fight your way through the streets!

[b]Download the free update, try out Jeff and Abore, and discover your new favorite fighter. The streets are calling—will you rise to the challenge?[/b]

notes.title: Jeff & Abore Join the Fight on May 6 – Free DLC Incoming
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Dragon Warriors! [/h1]

We’re back with a quick update to share some exciting news: Jeff and Abore are officially joining the roster of Double Dragon Gaiden: Rise of the Dragons as free DLC characters on May 6! 

We had originally mentioned an April release, but made the call to spend a bit more time fine-tuning the experience to make sure both fighters are as fun and polished as possible. Thank you for your patience—it’s almost time. 

[h1]Meet the New Challengers [/h1]

[h2]JEFF [/h2]
A childhood rival of the Lee brothers, Jeff trained in Sōsetsuken but couldn’t keep up with their skills. Frustrated and determined to prove himself, he abandoned the honorable path and forged his own ruthless style—blending street smarts with martial arts in a way that hits hard and hits dirty. 

[h2]ABORE[/h2] 
Towering, quiet, and unstoppable—Abore is a former soldier whose brute force makes him feel less like a man and more like a machine. With calm precision and devastating strength, Abore clears a path through enemies like a wrecking ball in slow motion. 

These new additions bring more variety to your brawling experience and open up brand-new strategies for solo and co-op play. Whether you're jumping in for the first time or returning to test new team combos, Jeff and Abore pack a punch. 

[h2]Free DLC drops May 6.  [/h2]

Make sure you're following Double Dragon Gaiden: Rise of the Dragons to get notified when the update goes live. Until then, stay sharp—and we’ll see you in the fight.

notes.title: Sacred Reunion DLC is out NOW, for FREE!
notes.content:
Hi Dragon Warriors, 

Are you ready to fight for the right to party?! Rejoin the radical streets of post-apocalyptic New York City with our Sacred Reunion DLC, out [b]NOW[/b] for [b]FREE[/b]!!

Sacred Reunion is packed with all new content, but what could we have possibly added? Here's the dealio.

💥 3 New Characters: Ranzou, Chin Sei Mei & Sonny
💻 Online Co-Op
💪 2 New Modes: Versus & Survival (both online enabled)
🐉 Tons of additional features, such as more powerups!

[previewyoutube=_wyFodNpyE4;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Double Dragon Gaiden: Sacred Reunion DLC Launch Trailer[/i]

[h2]Details[/h2]

[h3]1. Three New Playable Characters[/h3]

[b]SONNY LEE[/b]
Sonny is the lazy distant cousin of the Lee brothers. Just like Billy and Jimmy, he has practiced the art of Sōsetsuken since he was young, but he has a hard time keeping up. Instead, he opts to give the ancient technique his own creative spin and now wanders the streets to test the might of his new moves. 

[b]RANZOU[/b]
A mysterious young ninja from a secret organization known as the Secret Society of Ninjas. Ranzou has no stake in the fate of New York, but he is sent here by his organization as a test of his ability. 

[b]CHIN SEI MEI[/b]
Chin Sei Mei is the younger brother of Chin Tai Mei. While he was originally set to take over as the master of the Moko Gazanken Dojo, but he left the dojo in shame after learning of what his brother China Tai Mei has done. 

[h3]2. Online Co-op[/h3]

You've asked for online co-op and it's finally here! Matchmake with your friends or a random warrior online with our drop-in/drop-out Co-Op OR play online with our new game modes: Survival and Versus. 

[h3]3. Versus Mode[/h3]

Challenge your friends in intense 2-player battles with the newly introduced Versus Mode. Select two characters and upgrades to battle against your friends to prove who is the ultimate Dragon Warrior.

[h3]4. Survival Mode[/h3]

Test your skills and endurance in Survival Mode, where you'll face wave after wave of randomized enemies in ever-increasing difficulty levels. With the option to play solo or team up with a friend, Survival Mode offers a relentless challenge that will put your combat prowess to the test. Not for the faint of hearted. 

[h3]5. Six Unlockable Stages[/h3]

One, two, three, four, five, SIX stages! Unlock a variety of captivating stages for both Survival and Versus Modes, adding depth and visual flair to your battles. Many stages have unique environmental hazards, and can be unlocked through the Token Shop.  

[h3]6. New Upgrades[/h3]

Explore a range of new upgrades, including special move enhancements. Find your balance and experiment with new combinations to become the ultimate tag-team force.

[h3]Time to Rock![/h3]
So, what are you waiting for? Get in there and start pummeling some foes! As always, thank you for your support. Let us know how you feel about the update!

Until next time,
Your Secret Base and Maximum Entertainment teams

notes.title: The Second Patch is Live!
notes.content:
Hello Dragon Warriors!

We're excited to announce that today we've released our second patch for Double Dragon Gaiden: Rise of the Dragons! In it, you'll find invulnerability buffs, command run functionality and many quality of life changes. Here's the full list of patch notes. 

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[b]Movement Break Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Light brake/land no longer limits player's movement.
[*] Heavy brake/land duration are shortened.
[/list]

[b]Invulnerability Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Characters are invulnerable when performing throw and slam.
[*] Characters are invulnerable when knocked, unless they bounce off the wall.
[*] All grapple special moves are invulnerable if the player grabs the target successfully.
[*] Jimmy’s SP3 is invulnerable for a few frames on startup.
[*] Uncle Matin’s SP3 is invulnerable for a few frames on startup.
[*] Chin Tai Mei’s SP3 is invulnerable for a few frames on startup.
[*] Linda’s SP1 is invulnerable for a few frames on startup.
[*] Duke’s SP3 is invulnerable for a few frames on startup.
[/list]

[b]Command Run Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Billy, Jimmy, Chin Tai Mei and Linda will perform a dodge roll when you initiate running.
[*] When performing a dodge roll, they are invulnerable and can pick up items and weapons except dynamite. 
[*] Uncle Matin, Burnov and Willy pushes the target when you initiate running.
[*] Duke teleport and becomes invulnerable when you initiate running.
[*] Abobo has armor property when running.
[*] Anubis will disappear and becomes invulnerable after running for a while.
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous Gameplay Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Projectile and thrown weapons Z-Axis hitbox size has been reduced.
[*] Frequency of enemies attacking from out of screen has been reduced.
[*] Certain special moves for some characters have had minor buffs.
[*] Breakable object can also be broken with 2 stunlock hits.
[*] Since players were buffed with more invulnerability, the overall difficulty has increased (especially in earlier missions).
[*] HP recovered from hotdog has been reduced to 15.
[*] HP recovery from burger has been reduced to 40.
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous Quality of Life Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Mission Select's gang evolution cutscene can now be skipped.
[*] Gameplay tips have been added to Now Loading scenes.
[*] Through the option menu, you can choose to make defeated enemies disappear over time.
[*] Through the option menu, you can enable/disable screenshake.
[*] Through the option menu, you can enable/disable double tap forward to run.
[*] Through the option menu, you can enable/disable controller vibration.
[*] Through the option menu, you can enable/disable each HUD and floating HUD element.
[/list]

If you have any feedback or run into any bugs, please reach out on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/pfbHfZsMkR]Discord[/url] server or the Steam forums!

Until next time,
Your Secret Base and Modus teams

notes.title: The First Patch is Now Live!
notes.content:

Thank you to everyone who has played Double Dragon Gaiden: Rise of the Dragons! It’s been great watching you all fight against the clans and seeing you enjoy our passion project. Today, we released a patch that allows you to turn on/off Crowd Control notifications and fixes bugs such as leaderboard data errors. You can find the full list of patch notes below.

Patch Notes
[list]
[*] You can turn on/off Crowd Control notification in the option menu
[*] When you respawn, all enemies on screen will be knocked down to provide you a safe entry

[*] Fixed leaderboard data error
[*] Improved achievements detecting and tracking
[*] Improved controller recognition on supporting two controllers
[*] Fixed lag issue with V-Sync and G-Sync
[/list]

If you have any feedback or run into any bugs, please reach out on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/pfbHfZsMkR]Discord[/url] server or the Steam forums!

Until next time,
